messages:
maeve: Quick heads-up — Tessera POC is stuck on onboarding. SCIM provisioning keeps failing and their users aren’t hitting the Dedicated pool. Can we triage?

jordan: What error are they seeing from SCIM? Is this Okta or Azure AD?

olivia: it’s Okta for us. Error in the dashboard: "SCIM create user failed: missing attribute 'userName'". Also SAML attributes from our IdP aren’t showing timezone, causing app-level rules to fail.

maeve: Got it. Are they using SP-initiated SAML? Need SP metadata?

olivia: yes SP-initiated. We uploaded the metadata you provided yesterday (redwood-sp-metadata.xml). I can paste the error log: 

olivia: ```
2026-03-14T09:12:02Z ERROR scim: createUser failed status=400 body={"errors":[{"detail":"Missing required attribute: userName","status":"400"}]}
```

jordan: Typical Okta mapping issue — Okta’s SCIM app by default won’t send userName unless the mapping explicitly sets it. Also SAML attribute contract: if timezone is a custom attribute you need to add it to the app’s attribute statements and to the SAML assertion whitelist.

samir: Quick checklist I ran: 1) Confirm SCIM provisioning mapping includes userName -> user.email 2) In Okta app > Sign On > SAML Settings, add attribute statement name=timezone value=user.timezone (or set a transform) 3) Ensure Okta sends groups if we need route-by-group to Dedicated pool.

olivia: I can change the SCIM mapping but where should userName point? email or login?

jordan: Use email as userName for Redwood hosted keys. So mapping: userName = user.profile.email. For our Dedicated integration we expect both userName and active=true for provisioning.

maeve: Olivia, if you can flip that mapping and re-run provisioning we should see new create attempts in the POC logs. If still failing, paste the request body and we’ll inspect.

olivia: did that. Next run shows different error: 

olivia: ```
2026-03-14T09:22:11Z WARN scim: patch user failed status=403 body={"errors":[{"detail":"Unauthorized: token lacks scope scim.manage","status":"403"}]}
```

maeve: Ah — they used their Okta provisioning token for our old tenant. Need to re-generate a SCIM token scoped for the Tessera POC workspace. Jordan, can you create a scoped token?

jordan: On it. Creating a SCIM token with scim.manage scope for workspace tessera-poc...

deploy-bot: New service token created: scim-token-tessera-2026-03-14 (expires 2026-03-21)

jordan: Token created. Olivia — replace the token in Okta (Provisioning > Integration setup) and re-run. Also I added a temporary allowlist for the custom SAML attribute in the SP metadata so timezone will be accepted.

olivia: replaced token. provisioning run succeeded for the first 8 users. Groups still not mapped though. We rely on group->pool routing to land folks in Dedicated pool-7.

samir: For groups to map, Okta must send groups in the SAML assertion or we need SCIM group membership created. Two options: 1) add groups to assertion (attribute statement groups = user.groups) OR 2) provision groups via SCIM (requires Group push enabled). Which is easier for you?

olivia: we can push groups via SCIM but Okta admin wants to avoid group push for now. Easier to add groups to the assertion.

jordan: Ok; in SAML settings add attribute statement name=groups value=user.groups and make sure the assertion format is multivalued. Then in Console route rules set rule: if memberOf contains "tessera-dedicated" -> pool-7.

maeve: One more item: our Dedicated provisioning ran but pool wasn’t attached to their tenant due to a region mismatch. We accidentally created pool-7 in us-west while their workspace is eu-west. Samir — is there an automated move or do we recreate?

samir: We can’t move GPUs cross-region. I provisioned a new pool eu-2 for Tessera and attached it to the workspace. deploy-bot should report it.

deploy-bot: Dedicated pool provisioned: tessera-eu-2 (id: pool-eu-002) — attached to workspace tessera-poc.

maeve: Great. Olivia — after you add groups to the assertion and confirm SCIM token, can you retry and report final status?

olivia: will do this afternoon (timezone note: our Okta tenant default tz is UTC+10). I’ll post results here. Thanks y’all. :thumbsup:

jordan: If anything still breaks, paste the raw SAML assertion (redact PII) and we’ll eyeball. Also double-check cert rollover window in Okta — old cert caused assertions to be rejected earlier today.

maeve: Closing this thread once Tessera confirms success. Keeping notes here for handoff to CS.

olivia: confirmed — after groups= assertion and correct token, all 42 users provisioned and routing to tessera-eu-2. Thanks everyone! :tada:
